text: Here is how the owner records the customer's approval.
The estimate went out by email. The customer calls back. They want Unit 14 wrapped now, but not Unit 17. The owner opens Record approval.
The owner approves Unit 14 and declines Unit 17. They note who said yes, how they said it, and when. Then they save.
The approval record now shows on the estimate. Unit 17 is crossed out, and the total and deposit cover only Unit 14.
